newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese bank acquires troubled investment firm.
newsitem.headline: Chinese bank acquires troubled investment firm.

text.p: The troubled Beijing-based China Financial Trust and Investment Co (CFTIC) has been acquired by Guangdong Development Bank, a central bank statement said.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, took over CFTIC in October last year after CFTIC ran up heavy debts due to poor management and other problems.

China's Commercial Banking Law allows the central bank to take over a financial institution when it faces problems serious enough to threaten the interests of its depositors. This was the first such case.
"CFTIC has been acquired by the Guangdong Development Bank with all its debts and assets being taken over by the bank," the central bank said in a statement published in the Financial News.
"The People's Bank of China has thus ended its takeover of the CFTIC as from Oct 5 1996," it said, but gave no further details.
